name: aws/aws-lc
description: AWS's general-purpose cryptographic library based on BoringSSL and OpenSSL code, maintained by the AWS Cryptography team. Features optimized C and assembly implementations for TLS and common cryptographic algorithms on x86 and ARM.
score_rationale: Growing AWS-backed cryptographic library with 727 stars, consistently maintained through March 2026, providing FIPS-validated implementations for AWS customers.
